page_title: RBL 2-0 FRE | RB Leipzig v Freiburg 14/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The booking goes to Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg).
90+5' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) trips an opposition player and Robert Hartmann signals a foul. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+3' He should have scored! Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
90+2' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig in a dangerous position.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) makes a strong challenge and Robert Hartmann blows for a foul. RB Leipzig win a free kick.
88' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Castello Lukeba is replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
88' Here's the change. Christoph Baumgartner leaves the pitch and El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
87' The attendance is 30902.
87' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
85' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
85' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replaces Christian Gunter.
85' That will be all from Patrick Osterhage who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
84' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
83' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
81' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

81' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.

80' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) displays a great technique and excellent ball control. He weaves his way through the defence to the goal and fires the ball from inside the box, but it goes painfully wide of the left post.
79' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
77' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
75' A great run by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
74' It is time for a substitution. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) is on for Romulo Cardoso.

73' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save.
73' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes a short corner kick.
72' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. RB Leipzig get a corner.
72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
71' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Robert Hartmann had a clear view and blows his whistle.
69' A great run from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.

67' Yan Diomande provides the assist in the box, but Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
67' A sweet pass inside the box gives Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
65' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) has come on for Philipp Treu.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lucas Holer will be replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
63' Great teamplay by RB Leipzig as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
60' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) replacing Tidiam Gomis.
60' Substitution. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Assan Ouedraogo walks off.
56' 2 - 0 Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the top left corner, and thus alter the score to 2:0.
56' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
56' The referee awards a corner and David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.

55' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Noah Atubolu. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
55' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Yuito Suzuki will be replaced by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
53' 1 - 0 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds the head of Willi Orban (RB Leipzig), who rises and produces an amazing header inside the right post.
53' Today's referee Robert Hartmann rightly decides to book Philipp Treu (Freiburg) for his harsh tackle.
50' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
50' The referee blows his whistle as David Raum (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in his challenge. Freiburg have been awarded a free kick.
47' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+1' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle after Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Freiburg.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
43' Freiburg are ruled offside.
41' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu keeps it out with an amazing save.

39' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
37' Poor challenge! Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is penalised for tripping and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. Freiburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

35' The corner kick picks out Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
35' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
35' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Referee Robert Hartmann sees the trip by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
32' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

31' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Noah Atubolu anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
30' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

29' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Philipp Treu is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
27' A cross into the box from Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
27' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
25' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Robert Hartmann stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Freiburg have a free kick.
24' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
22' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Holer (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

21' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
19' David Raum (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Hartmann saw the whole situation. Freiburg will take a free kick.
18' The corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is hurriedly cleared.
16' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
14' A yellow card for a tackle by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg). Robert Hartmann doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
14' A clumsy foul by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. RB Leipzig are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
13' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
12' A raking crossfield pass from Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
12' Robert Hartmann blows the whistle, Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig.
11' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
9' The Freiburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
6' A pass from Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by Noah Atubolu and the move breaks down.
5' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Robert Hartmann is the one to supervise the game today.
